text:
F-w36h, source-assisted reading. Reread on the images by a research reader with the Gulden legende text (ed. Kuiper from Brussels KBR 15140, chapter "Vander wiinghen der kerken", printed pp. 774-776) at hand: recto column b, recto column a lines 1-12, verso column a last four lines, verso column b upper strip. Not an independent reading. Accuracy has not been measured.
Conventions: (..) expansion; [..] lost or supplied from the source; ? uncertain; / not used, one manuscript line per line. Boxes are native pixels of the 4012 x 5652 images.
